tools.name: get_pct_leg
tools.description: One of the 26 Pacific Crest Trail legs walked in 2021 (resupply to resupply): FarOut trail miles, length, 2021 days and dates, and the page that covers it.

tools.name: find_by_trail_mile
tools.description: Given a PCT trail mile (FarOut miles, 0 to 2656.4), returns the leg it falls in and the nearest towns, passes and lakes with their miles.

tools.name: vegan_resupply
tools.description: Vegan resupply at common PCT stops: what each town or store carries, whether a mailed box is advised, and the date each entry was last checked. Search by town name, or by a mile range.

tools.name: list_pct_points
tools.description: Towns, passes, lakes and peaks along the PCT with trail mile, coordinates and trail height in feet. Filter by kind or section.
